    assert payment.status == "authorized"

from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment

from ledgerly import audit

capture_partial(p, Decimal("60.005"), T0)

print("audit:", audit.events("payment_captured"))
# over authorized
p2 = Payment("p2","i",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
try: capture_partial(p2, Decimal("100.01"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over:", e.code)
# non-positive
p3 = Payment("p3","i",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
try: capture_partial(p3, Decimal("0"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("zero:", e.code)
# wrong state
p4 = Payment("p4","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0)
try: capture_partial(p4, Decimal("10"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state:", e.code)
# tz normalization
p5 = Payment("p5","i",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
capture_partial(p5, Decimal("10"), datetime(2026,1,1,5,tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=5))))
print("utc:", p5.captured_at)
# idempotency
p6 = Payment("p6","i",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
capture_partial(p6, Decimal("10"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
capture_partial(p6, Decimal("20"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
print("idem amount:", p6.amount, "events:", len(audit.events("payment_captured")))
EOF"}
